opening.argument: The speaker invites viewers to join Bitconnect through a referral link while describing an expected $1,000 return from a $10,000 investment after 80 days. He expressly connects earnings to money reinvested daily, and the account interface presents lending, reinvestment, and daily-profit participation, as well as a mechanism to earn by referring new members. The dashboard displays investment and earnings figures, but also shows no capital released. Those screens do not independently establish that the displayed balances, transactions, promised returns, or recovery of capital were genuine or withdrawable. Taken together, the referral solicitation, stated return, reinvestment structure, and member-referral earnings mechanism establish an investment-pool, lending, or staking-return scheme presented to viewers without verified payment or capital recovery.
